characters.name: Alok
characters.introEn: An active aura ability described by Garena as healing and movement support for Alok and nearby allies.
characters.introHi: Active aura ability jo Garena ke mutabik Alok aur nearby allies ko healing aur movement support deti hai.
currentEn: Creates a 5m aura that raises movement speed by 15% and restores 5 HP/s for 10 seconds.
Effects from several Drop the Beat auras do not stack.

Awakened Party Remix drops music notes 2m behind the user every 2 seconds while the aura is active; each note lasts 5 seconds. Teammates who pick up a note receive 15% movement speed and 5 HP/s for 10 seconds.
currentHi: 5m aura movement speed 15% badhati hai aur 10 seconds tak 5 HP/s restore karti hai.
Multiple Drop the Beat auras ke effects stack nahi hote.

Awakened Party Remix aura active hone par har 2 seconds mein user ke 2m peeche music notes drop karta hai; har note 5 seconds rehta hai. Note pick karne wale teammate ko 10 seconds ke liye 15% movement speed aur 5 HP/s milta hai.
notesEn: OB54 Skill Boost choices are Battle Royale-only; only one boost can be selected.
OB53 documents that Alok cannot benefit from a teammate's aura while his own skill is active.
notesHi: OB54 Skill Boost choices sirf Battle Royale mode ke liye hain; ek hi boost select hota hai.
OB53 ke mutabik Alok apni skill active hone par teammate ke aura ka benefit nahi le sakta.
historyEn: OB39: HP recovery was reduced from 5 to 3 HP/s and cooldown changed from 50s to 45s.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): HP recovery returned to 5 HP/s; movement speed 15%, duration 10s and cooldown 45s; Party Remix note effects documented.
OB52: ability-range visual mismatch and speed-application bugs fixed.
OB53: own-skill aura interaction rule documented.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): BR Skill Boost options added.
OB55: no change.
historyHi: OB39: HP recovery 5 se 3 HP/s hui aur cooldown 50s se 45s hua.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): HP recovery 5 HP/s hui; movement speed 15%, duration 10s aur cooldown 45s; Party Remix note effects document hue.
OB52: ability-range visual mismatch aur speed-application bugs fix hue.
OB53: own-skill aura interaction rule document hua.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): BR Skill Boost options add hue.
OB55: koi change nahi.

hiddenMechanics.text: The official OB53 notes document a restriction on receiving another Alok aura while your own is active.

awakened.label: Awakened
awakened.introEn: Awakened version of Drop the Beat with music-note interactions.
awakened.introHi: Drop the Beat ka awakened version jisme music-note interactions hain.
currentEn: While the aura is active, music notes drop 2m behind the skill user every 2 seconds.
Each note lasts 5 seconds; teammates who pick one up receive +15% movement speed and 5 HP/s for 10 seconds.
currentHi: Aura active hone par har 2 seconds mein skill user ke 2m peeche music notes drop hote hain.
Har note 5 seconds rehta hai; pick karne wale teammate ko 10 seconds ke liye +15% movement speed aur 5 HP/s milta hai.

rows.value: +15% movement speed and 5 HP/s for 10 seconds

notesEn: The awakened variant is shown separately from the base ability.
notesHi: Awakened variant ko base ability se alag dikhaya gaya hai.

historyHi: OB45: Party Remix music-note mechanics document hui.

characters.name: A124
characters.introEn: An electromagnetic-wave ability described in Garena patch notes as interfering with opposing character skills.
characters.introHi: Electromagnetic-wave ability jise Garena patch notes opposing character skills mein interference ke roop mein describe karte hain.
currentEn: Unleashes an 8m electromagnetic wave around A124.
Enemies within the wave cannot activate their skills; the effect also interrupts certain interaction countdowns such as reviving.
The supplied late-2023 patch-note record lists 25 damage and a 20-second effect duration.
currentHi: A124 ke around 8m electromagnetic wave release hoti hai.
Wave ke andar enemies apni skills activate nahi kar sakte; yeh revive jaise kuch interaction countdowns ko bhi interrupt karti hai.
Supplied late-2023 patch-note record 25 damage aur 20-second effect duration list karta hai.

rows.value: 50 seconds (patch note; official character page lists 75s)

notesEn: Cooldown conflict: the late-2023 patch note lists 50s, while Garena's character page lists 75s. Keep the conflict visible and verify in game.
The supplied official notes describe Joseph as immune to A124's nano interference.
A124's skill can be cancelled while aiming, according to the supplied patch-note record.
notesHi: Cooldown conflict: late-2023 patch note 50s list karta hai, jabki Garena character page 75s list karta hai. Conflict visible rakhein aur game mein verify karein.
Supplied official notes Joseph ko A124 nano interference se immune batate hain.
Supplied patch-note record ke mutabik A124 ki skill aiming ke dauran cancel ho sakti hai.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): reworked into an 8m wave that disables skills; the patch described level-based duration and cooldown ranges.
Late 2023 (approx. Oct–Nov): official patch-note record lists 25 damage, 20s duration and a 50s cooldown; cooldown conflicts with the current character page.
OB55: no change.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): 8m wave skill-disable rework hua; patch mein level-based duration aur cooldown ranges diye gaye.
Late 2023 (approx. Oct–Nov): official patch-note record 25 damage, 20s duration aur 50s cooldown list karta hai; cooldown current character page se conflict karta hai.
OB55: koi change nahi.

characters.name: Andrew
characters.introEn: A passive ability profile covering Andrew's armor-specialist trait and awakened Wolf Pack variant.
characters.introHi: Passive ability profile jo Andrew ke Armor Specialist trait aur awakened Wolf Pack variant ko cover karti hai.
currentEn: Armor Specialist reduces vest durability loss by 40%.
Awakened Wolf Pack adds 4% armor damage reduction, plus 1% per teammate within 15m.
currentHi: Armor Specialist vest durability loss ko 40% reduce karta hai.
Awakened Wolf Pack 4% armor damage reduction add karta hai, plus 15m ke andar har teammate par 1%.
notesEn: OB46 changed the teammate bonus to a 15m proximity condition.
The supplied research flags an in-game wording check about whether nearby teammates must also equip Wolf Pack.
Shield Points are not reduced by armor damage-reduction effects.
notesHi: OB46 ne teammate bonus ke liye 15m proximity condition set ki.
Supplied research mein verify karna baaki hai ki nearby teammates ko bhi Wolf Pack equip karna zaroori hai ya nahi.
Shield Points par armor damage-reduction effects apply nahi hote.
historyEn: Approx. Jun 2023: Armor Specialist increased from 20% to 25%.
OB41: Wolf Pack armor damage reduction changed from 20% to 15%, with teammate bonus adjusted.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Armor Specialist increased from 25% to 40%; Wolf Pack values adjusted.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Wolf Pack changed to +4%, plus +1% per teammate within 15m.
OB55: no change.
historyHi: Approx. Jun 2023: Armor Specialist 20% se 25% hua.
OB41: Wolf Pack armor damage reduction 20% se 15% hua aur teammate bonus adjust hua.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): Armor Specialist 25% se 40% hua; Wolf Pack values adjust hui.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Wolf Pack +4% aur 15m ke andar har teammate par +1% hua.
OB55: koi change nahi.

hiddenMechanics.text: Garena's Shield Points explanation states that Shield Points are not affected by armor damage-reduction effects.

needsRecheck: Confirm whether nearby teammates must also carry Wolf Pack for the teammate bonus.

characters.name: Antonio
characters.introEn: A passive ability that grants additional Shield Points at the start of a match, as described in Garena's official notes.
characters.introHi: Passive ability jo match ke start par additional Shield Points deti hai, jaisa Garena ke official notes mein describe hai.
currentEn: Starts the match with 20 extra Shield Points.
Shield Points recover after surviving combat; the supplied patch record lists a recovery speed of 5 SP/s.
Shield Points are deducted before HP and are not reduced by armor damage-reduction buffs.
currentHi: Match 20 extra Shield Points ke saath start hota hai.
Combat survive karne ke baad Shield Points recover hote hain; supplied patch record recovery speed 5 SP/s list karta hai.
Shield Points HP se pehle deduct hote hain aur armor damage-reduction buffs se reduce nahi hote.
notesEn: Shield Points do not protect against Danger Zone, fall damage or constant bleeding damage.
The 5 SP/s recovery-speed change is recorded in the supplied research as a 2024 patch affecting Shield Points.
notesHi: Shield Points Danger Zone, fall damage ya constant bleeding damage se protect nahi karte.
5 SP/s recovery-speed change supplied research mein 2024 Shield Points patch ke roop mein record hai.
historyEn: OB41 (approx. Aug 2023): reworked from extra HP to Shield Points; regeneration begins after a period without damage.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): starting Shield Points adjusted from 40 to 30.
Approx. Aug–Sep 2024: Shield Points recovery speed changed from 10 to 5 SP/s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): starting Shield Points changed from 30 to 20.
OB55: no change.
historyHi: OB41 (approx. Aug 2023): extra HP se Shield Points mein rework hua; damage na hone ke baad regeneration start hoti hai.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): starting Shield Points 40 se 30 hue.
Approx. Aug–Sep 2024: Shield Points recovery speed 10 se 5 SP/s hui.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): starting Shield Points 30 se 20 hue.
OB55: koi change nahi.

hiddenMechanics.text: Official Shield Points notes state that Shield Points are not affected by armor damage-reduction effects and do not cover certain environmental damage.

needsRecheck: Older patch release dates in the supplied research are approximate.
